meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

howto.what: 装上后，当要做较长或多场景视频时，Claude会按流程创建或编辑自定义HyperFrames合成：先检查技能更新，再根据已有项目文件决定续作或新建，然后规划场景、构建画面与动画，并调用媒体处理工具。适用于品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环等。
howto.when: 当没有专门流程适用，或BRIEF.md指定flow为companion时触发。典型用于品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环等较长或多场景作品；新创建作品需先经过hyperframes流程。
